newsitem.title: USA: PLM Intl says will not pursue Equis offer.
newsitem.headline: PLM Intl says will not pursue Equis offer.

text.p: PLM International Inc, an equipment leasing and management company, on Tuesday said its board of directors has decided not to pursue a $5.00 per share acquisition offer from Equis Financial Group LP.
In a statement, PLM said its board's decision was based on numerous factors, including the current stock price, its business strategy and advice from financial and legal counsel.
The company also said it is committed to a previously announced stock repurchase program and has hired Josephthal Lyon and Ross Inc to assist it in reviewing financial and strategic alternatives.
